baseline.name: hand-fit-scorer-v0-2026-11-11
baseline.trained_on: 230,010 random deals bid by the Gen 5 bidder (seed 2000), 22 minutes on 2 cores

code.change: gen_fit.py reads the bidder path from SDB_BIDDER (reports/hand-fit-scorer-v1a-2026-11-11/analysis-auction-belief.patch); the recipe is otherwise v0's

bidder.name: Gen 6 candidate bidder (graded alternatives)
bidder.check: the NumPy bidder with these weights reproduces 150 of 150 recorded Gen 6 self-play auctions (all four seats)

data.per_seat: the true hand, 3 random hands and 5 hands with 1-8 cards swapped, each labelled by replaying the seat's calls greedily with the bidder
data.kept: deals with a contract and an auction of at most 25 calls

training.recipe: v0's: widths 768/512/256, Adam, batch 1024, cosine learning rate 2e-3 to 1e-4 over the time budget, 200 warm-up steps
training.validation_during_training: first 40,000 rows of the Gen 6 seed-9 validation set; log in train_log.txt

validation.note: seed 9, the seed of v0's validation set; the same random deals bid by each bidder; all rows scored

at_the_table.selection: tricks 6-12, at least two legal cards, two hidden hands, at most 20,000 card-fit layouts (every layout listed, as the Gen 6 deal list)
at_the_table.metric: nats per decision: log P(true layout) under the weights minus log P(true layout) under equal weights; standard errors clustered by board

v1a_power_1.5_minus_v0_power_1.note: power 1.5 chosen on each half of the boards (even and odd episodes) and scored on the other; both halves chose 1.5

not_measured: auctions of BEN, dds-40000 or other bidders
the Gen 7 policy net with v1a's readings as inputs
